name: claude-code-mods
description: Mods for Claude Code that watch a real session and speak up only when they have something to say.

plugins.name: receipts
plugins.description: Checks what Claude and its helpers say they did against what really happened. Speaks up only when a claim has no proof.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: When Claude changes a function, tells it every place that function is used, and asks you only if some of those files were never opened.

plugins.name: crew
plugins.description: A crew of models for one task: the best model plans and signs off, a mid model builds, a small one runs the checks. Starts in practice mode, which changes nothing.

plugins.name: pit-stop
plugins.description: Cleans Claude's memory at a good moment and shows what goes and what stays. Holds an automatic clean-up while Claude is in the middle of a multi-file change.
